subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a typed global/per-model non-resetting generation timeout under agent model config, or keep operators on existing run, provider, idle, and first-event timeout surfaces while solving narrower stalls separately?
rationale: This would add a compatibility-sensitive public config/default surface in provider routing and fallback behavior, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs.

options.title: Define per-model generation timeout
options.body: Add a typed global and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and regression tests.

options.title: Use existing timeout surfaces
options.body: Decline the new key and improve docs around provider timeout, run timeout, first-event timeout, and idle watchdog behavior.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Route thinking stalls and repeated-output loops to narrower canonical issues and keep generation timeout out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Define per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Add a typed global and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on this issue's config/product framing and adjacent timeout/config changes.
